name: qq-bridge
description: QQ <-> DSH bridge: relays triggering QQ messages into a `dsh --profile sdk` agent session and sends the answer back. Replaces the in-process llm.stream design of packages/dsh-qq-bot.

scripts.test: node mocks/verify-manifest.mjs && node mocks/verify-config.mjs && node mocks/verify-units.mjs && node mocks/verify-local.mjs && node mocks/verify-credentials.mjs && node mocks/verify-images.mjs && node mocks/verify-rpc.mjs && node mocks/verify-lifecycle.mjs && node mocks/verify-memory-store.mjs && node mocks/verify-process-guard.mjs && node mocks/verify-onebot.mjs && node mocks/verify-mcp.mjs && node mocks/verify-mcp-profile.mjs && node mocks/verify-real-dsh.mjs && node mocks/verify-doctor.mjs && node mocks/verify-api.mjs && node mocks/verify-apitest.mjs

comment.dependencies: 运行期依赖不走 npm，而是由 setup.mjs 复制到 vendor/node_modules（这样整个包可以整体搬走）。下面的 dependencies 只是给手工 npm install 时作参考。
